blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: We propose DINO-FIL, a transformer-based framework for pixel-level localization of generative image forgeries. The method leverages multi-layer representations from a pretrained DINOv3 ViT-H+/16 encoder combined with a lightweight fusion decoder to capture both semantic structure and fine-grained texture inconsistencies introduced by image editing. By aggregating intermediate transformer features across depths, the model improves sensitivity to subtle, spatially localized artifacts that are often missed by standard single-layer approaches. We evaluate DINO-FIL in a cross-dataset setting, training on B-Free and testing on Beyond the Brush, CocoGlide, TGIF, and SAGI-D. The model achieves strong generalization, outperforming existing baselines on average and on four of five evaluated datasets, while maintaining a high true negative rate on pristine images.
blocks.zh: 我们提议DINO-FIL,一个基于变压器的框架,用于将基因成像假象本地化. 该方法利用了由被预先训练的DINOv3 VIT-H+/16编码器与轻量级聚变解码器相结合的多层表示来捕捉由图像编辑引入的语义结构和精细纹理不一致. 该模型通过集成跨深度的中间变压器特征,提高了对微妙而空间局部的文物的敏感性,而这些文物往往被标准的单层方法所忽略. 我们通过跨数据集、无B培训以及 " 刷子 " 、 " CocoGlide " 、 " TGIF " 和 " SAGI-D " 测试来评估DINO-FIL。 该模型实现了强烈的概括化,平均比现有基线和5个评估数据集中的4个要好,同时在原始图像上保持了较高的真实负率.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Generative image editing has rapidly improved in visual quality and accessibility. Text-guided and mask-guided inpainting systems can now remove, replace, or regenerate selected image regions while preserving global scene coherence, making manipulated content increasingly difficult to recognize from visual inspection alone [ 5 ] . Unlike conventional manipulations such as splicing or copy-move editing, generative inpainting can synthesize new content inside a user-specified mask and blend it into the surrounding context. This is particularly challenging in fully regenerated settings, where the edited region is synthesized jointly with its local visual context rather than inserted as an externally pasted region. As a result, traditional image forgery localization methods may not observe clear low-level discontinuities [ 10 , 9 ] . Reliable localization of inpainted regions is therefore an important task for image forensics, media verification, and downstream trustworthiness analysis.
blocks.zh: 基因图像编辑在视觉质量和可获取性方面迅速改善. 文本制导和遮罩制导的涂装系统现在可以在保持全球场景一致性的同时去除、替换或重新生成选定的图像区域,使被操纵的内容越来越难以单独从视觉检查中识别[5]。 不同于传统的操纵,如斯皮克或复制-移动编辑,基因化的涂装可以合成用户指定面具内的新内容,并混入周围上下文. 在完全重新生成的环境下,这尤其具有挑战性,因为编辑区域是结合其当地视觉环境合成的,而不是作为外部粘贴区域插入的。 因此,传统的图像伪造本地化方法可能无法观察到明显的低水平不连续[10,9]. 因此,可靠地将油漆区域本地化是图像法证、媒体核查和下游可信度分析的重要任务。

blocks.en: In this work, we address dense image inpainting localization. Given an RGB image, the goal is to predict a pixel-level binary mask that separates inpainted regions from authentic image content. Unlike image-level synthetic detection, dense inpainting localization targets a finer-grained, pixel-level task: identifying edited regions by detecting subtle statistical inconsistencies and visual artifacts, such as boundary discontinuities between authentic and synthesized content. In this setting, “edited” does not necessarily mean that the background pixels remain unchanged. Depending on the editing workflow, the background may either stay pixel-identical to the original image or be regenerated together with the modified region. In the latter case, pixel-level changes can occur across the entire image while preserving the background’s semantic content, potentially destroying the local forensic traces needed for inpainting localization, even though image-level synthetic detection may still succeed [ 9 ] .
blocks.zh: 在这个作品中,我们处理密集的图像涂抹本地化问题. 考虑到一个RGB图像,目标是预测一个像素级的二进制面具,将涂片区域与真实图像内容区分开来. 与图像级合成探测不同,密集的涂装局部化针对的是更细腻,像素级的任务:通过检测微妙的统计不一致和视觉文物来识别编辑区域,如真实和合成内容之间的边界不连续. 在此情况下,“编辑”并不一定意味着背景像素保持不变。 根据编辑工作流程的不同,背景可能要么与原始图像保持像素-等同,要么与修改区域一起重新生成. 在后一种情况下,像素水平的变化可以在整个图像中发生,同时保留背景的语义内容,有可能破坏局部化所需的局部法证痕迹,即使图像水平合成检测仍然可能成功[9].

blocks.en: Recent inpainting-focused benchmarks such as TGIF [ 10 ] , Beyond the Brush (BtB) [ 1 ] , SAGI-D [ 5 ] , CocoGlide [ 6 ] , and B-Free [ 7 ] reflect this shift toward realistic local edits.
blocks.zh: 近期的绘画重点基准,如 TGIF [10], Beyond the Brush (BtB) [1], SAGI-D [5], CocoGlide [6], B-Free [7] 反映了这种向现实的本地编辑转变.

blocks.en: Pretrained vision backbones have become central to image forensics. TruFor [ 6 ] leverages a pretrained vision transformer architecture to process RGB images together with learned noise-sensitive traces for general forgery localization. In parallel, self-supervised ViT backbones such as DINO [ 3 ] provide transferable dense representations that can be adapted to localize subtle generative traces. DinoLizer [ 2 ] demonstrates the value of DINOv2 [ 12 ] patch embeddings for generative inpainting localization and reports strong cross-dataset performance.
blocks.zh: 预先训练的视觉骨干已成为图像法证的核心. TruFor [6] 利用一个经过预先训练的视觉变压器架构,将RGB图像与学到的噪声敏感痕迹一起处理,用于一般的伪造本地化. 同时,DINO[3]等自我监督的ViT骨干提供了可转移的密集表示,可以适应于将微妙的基因痕迹本地化. DinoLizer [2] 演示了DINOv2 [12] 补丁嵌入值,用于基因涂抹局部化,并报告强跨数据集性能.

blocks.en: However, existing DINO-based localization methods typically rely on final-layer features [ 2 , 14 ] . Forensic methods primarily rely on low-level artifacts such as compression and sensor noise [ 10 ] , while modern vision foundation models encode higher-level semantic structure in image representations, motivating the use of multi-level features. Multi-level fusion is a standard principle in dense prediction [ 8 , 13 , 4 ] ; for ViTs, intermediate hidden states provide a natural hierarchy of local, structural, and semantic information.
blocks.zh: 然而,现有的基于DINO的本地化方法通常依赖于最终层特征[2,14]. 法医学方法主要依靠低级文物,如压缩和感应噪声[10],而现代视觉基础模型在图像表达中编码了更高层次的语义结构,激发了多层次特征的使用. 多层聚变是密集预测[8,13,4]中的一项标准原理;对于ViTs来说,中间隐藏状态提供了本地,结构,语义信息的自然层次.

blocks.en: We propose DINO-FIL , a dense F orensic I npainting L ocalization framework built on a pretrained DINOv3 ViT-H+/16 encoder and a lightweight multi-layer fusion decoder. DINO-FIL extracts hidden states from several backbone depths, projects them to a common channel dimension, enriches them with lightweight multi-scale context modules inspired by atrous spatial pyramid pooling (ASPP) [ 4 ] , and fuses them in a top-down decoder inspired by feature pyramid networks (FPN) [ 8 ] . Since all selected DINOv3 hidden states share the same patch-grid resolution, DINO-FIL treats transformer depth, rather than spatial scale, as the fusion hierarchy. This enables the model to combine local appearance cues, texture- and pattern-sensitive intermediate representations, and higher-level semantic context. We further study partial encoder fine-tuning with a lower learning rate for unfrozen DINOv3 layers than for the newly initialized decoder.
blocks.zh: 我们提出DINO-FIL,一个密集的F orensic I 涂装L 缩放框架,它基于一个事先训练的DINOv3 VIT-H+/16编码器和一个轻量级多层聚变解码器. DINO-FIL从几个主干深度中提取隐藏状态,将其投影到一个共同的通道维度,用由原子空间金字塔集合(ASPP)[4]启发的轻量级多尺度上下文模块丰富它们,并将它们装入由特征金字塔网络(FPN)[8]启发的自上而下的解码器中. 由于所有选定的DINOv3隐藏状态都具有相同的补丁-网格分辨率,DINO-FIL将变压器深度而不是空间尺度作为聚变结构. 这使得模型能够结合局部的外观提示,纹理和图案敏感的中间表示,以及更高层次的语义上下文. 我们进一步研究部分编码器微调,对未冻结的DINOv3层的学习率低于新初始化的解码器。

blocks.en: In summary, our contributions are threefold: • We introduce DINO-FIL, a DINOv3-based dense inpainting localization model that fuses intermediate transformer features from multiple backbone depths rather than relying only on the final layer. • We systematically study encoder adaptation and show that partial fine-tuning of later DINOv3 layers improves inpainting localization while full encoder fine-tuning provides limited additional benefit. • We provide a cross-dataset evaluation of our proposed approach against strong forensic baselines and show that high-resolution inference substantially improves inpainting localization, while maintaining low false-positive rates on pristine images.
blocks.zh: 总而言之,我们的贡献有三个方面: 我们引入了DINO-FIL,一种基于DINov3的密集涂装本地化模型,将中间变压器的特性从多个主干深度熔化,而不是只依赖最后一层. • . 我们系统地研究编码器的适应性,并表明,对后来的DINOv3层进行部分微调可以改善对本地化的油漆,而完全的编码器微调能提供有限的额外好处。 我们对照强有力的法证基线,对我们的拟议方法进行跨数据集评价,并表明高分辨率推论大大改进了局部化,同时在原始图像上保持较低的虚假阳性率。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Pre-trained Vision Transformers in Image Forensics
blocks.zh: 2.1 图像法证领域经过培训的视觉变形器

blocks.en: The adaptation of pre-trained Vision Transformers (ViTs) has emerged as a dominant paradigm for discovering localized anomalies in visual media. A prominent milestone in this space is TruFor [ 6 ] , which utilizes a pre-trained SegFormer backbone architecture coupled with a learned noise-print stream to map localized forgery traces. While TruFor remains a heavily cited baseline, it is engineered for general image manipulation detection and localization (IMDL). Consequently, its training regimes and evaluation benchmarks encompass a wide variety of traditional manipulations (such as splicing, copy-move, and removal) rather than dedicating focus to the specific artifacts of generative AI inpainting.
blocks.zh: 对经过预先训练的视觉变形器(ViTs)的改造,已成为在视觉媒体中发现局部异常的主导范式. 这个空间中一个突出的里程碑是TruFor [6],它利用一个经过事先训练的SegFormer主干架构,加上一个学习的噪声印刷流来映射局部的伪造痕迹. 虽然TruFor仍然是大量引用的基线,但它是为一般图像操纵探测和本地化(IMDL)而设计的. 因此,其培训制度和评价基准包括各种各样的传统操纵(如打针、抄袭和清除),而不是将注意力集中在基因化AI印记的具体文物上。

blocks.en: Parallel to traditional end-to-end architectures, an emerging paradigm in dense forensic tasks explores leveraging the robust representation spaces of massive vision foundation models. DinoLizer [ 2 ] establishes that self-supervised representations from DINOv2 contain rich, localized artifacts useful for dense binary forgery segmentation. To handle arbitrary image dimensions, overlapping image crops are cut out of the target image and all crops are processed by the DINO backbone sequentially. A 1 × \times 1 convolutional layer is then used to infer localized logit maps directly from the patch embeddings, which are subsequently aggregated to construct the final heatmap.
blocks.zh: 与传统的端对端架构平行的是,密集的法证任务的新兴范式探索利用大规模愿景基础模型的强大代表空间. DinoLizer[2]规定,DINOv2的自我监督的表示中含有丰富,局部的文物,可用于密集的二元伪造分解. 为了处理任意的图像维度,重叠的图像作物被从目标图像中剪除,所有作物由DINO主干线按顺序处理. 然后使用1×\time 1 演化层从补丁嵌入直接推断本地化的对数图,这些图随后被聚合来构建最终的热映射.

blocks.en: Yu et al. [ 14 ] introduce a baseline that applies Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) to a frozen DINOv3 backbone paired with a lightweight convolutional decoder. Similar to TruFor, Yu et al.’s framework targets broad image forensics across diverse manipulation types rather than focusing exclusively on generative AI inpainting.
blocks.zh: 余等编. [14] 引入一个基线,将低Rank适应(LORA)适用于冷冻的DINOv3主干线与轻量级转录解码器配对. 与TruFor类似, Yu等人的框架针对的是各种操纵类型的广义图像鉴证,而不是完全专注于基因化的AI涂装.

blocks.en: 2.2 Architectural Distinctions in DINO-FIL
blocks.zh: 2.2 DINO-FIL的建筑特征

blocks.en: Our proposed framework, DINO-FIL, fundamentally departs from these existing DINO-based approaches in two key architectural and task-specific dimensions:
blocks.zh: 我们拟议的框架,即DINO-FIL,在两个关键的建筑和具体任务方面从根本上背离了这些基于DINO的现有办法:

blocks.en:
• Feature Extraction Strategy: While both DinoLizer and Yu et al. rely exclusively on extracting features from the final layer of the DINO backbone, DINO-FIL systematically taps into the internal depth hierarchy of a high-capacity ViT-H+ encoder – extracting intermediate hidden states from layers 8, 16, 24, and 32 to capture both low-level texture boundaries and high-level semantic inconsistencies. • Fine-Tuning & Learning Rate Paradigm: While both DinoLizer and Yu et al. evaluate full-parameter fine-tuning of the DINO encoder, their implementations default to training the entire backbone, utilizing a single global learning rate across both the encoder and decoder networks.
In contrast, DINO-FIL adopts a more targeted optimization strategy. We investigate both full-parameter fine-tuning and fine-tuning restricted to the later transformer layers, and introduce discriminative learning rates that decouple the adaptation pace of the pretrained backbone from that of the newly initialized decoder. This helps preserve the integrity of the backbone’s foundational features while allowing the decoder to specialize for the localization task.
blocks.zh:
• 采掘特征 战略:虽然DinoLizer和Yu等人都是这样。 完全依靠DINO骨干末层的提取特征,DINO-FIL系统地挖掘到一个高容量的VIT-H+编码器的内部深度层次——从第8,16,24和32层提取中间隐藏状态,以捕捉低层纹理边界和高层次语义不一致. • 善待和学习 比例范式 : 虽然DinoLizer和Yu等人都对DINO编码器的全参数微调进行评价,但其实施默认将培训整个主干线,同时在编码器和解码器网络中采用单一的全球学习率。
与此相反,DINO-FIL采取了更有针对性的优化战略。 我们既调查全参数的微调,又调查仅限于后期变压器层的微调,并采用差别化的学习率,将预训骨干与新初始化解码器的适应速度脱钩. 这有助于维护骨干基础特征的完整性,同时允许解码器专门用于本地化任务.

blocks.en: 4 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4 实验设置

blocks.en: 4.1 Datasets
blocks.zh: 4.1 数据集

blocks.en: We evaluate DINO-FIL on a cross-dataset image inpainting localization benchmark. To make the results comparable to DinoLizer, which uses the same dataset-level training setup, DINO-FIL is trained on B-Free and evaluated on Beyond the Brush, CocoGlide, TGIF, SAGI-D, and B-Free. The reorganized B-Free split contains 206,065 training images, 25,755 validation images, and 25,765 test images. However, for evaluation we follow the benchmark protocol and test on 10,000 B-Free test images. The B-Free test split is included to measure in-domain performance, while the remaining datasets are used to assess cross-dataset generalization. In total, DINO-FIL is tested on 28,835 images, comprising 10,000 B-Free, 3,896 Beyond the Brush, 512 CocoGlide, 4,249 TGIF, and 10,178 SAGI-D test images.
blocks.zh: 我们用一个跨数据集图像对本地化基准进行评估。 为了使结果与使用相同数据集级培训设置的DinoLizer具有可比性,DINO-FIL接受了B-Free培训,并在Beyond the Brush,CocoGlide,TGIF,SAGI-D和B-Free上进行了评价. 重组后的B-Free分割包含206,065个训练图像,25,755个验证图像,以及25,765个测试图像. 然而,为了评价,我们遵循基准协议,测试10,000个B-Free测试图像。 B-Free测试拆分被包含在内,以测量域内性能,而剩余的数据集则用于评估跨数据集的泛化. DINO-FIL总共对28 835幅图像进行了测试,其中包括10 000幅无B图像,3 896幅 Brush之外,512 CocoGlide,4,249 TGIF,以及10,178 SAGI-D测试图像.

blocks.en: 4.2 Training Protocol
blocks.zh: 4.2 训练议定书

blocks.en: DINO-FIL is trained as a binary segmentation model for dense inpainting localization. The network predicts a single-channel logit map, which is supervised with the binary ground-truth manipulation mask. The training objective combines binary cross-entropy with logits and Dice loss: ℒ = ℒ BCE + ℒ Dice . \mathcal{L}=\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{BCE}}+\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{Dice}}. (8) This objective encourages both accurate pixel-wise classification and spatial overlap between the predicted and ground-truth manipulation masks.
blocks.zh: DINO-FIL作为密集涂抹局部化的二进制分解模型被培训. 网络预测一个单通道的日志映射,由二进制地面真伪操纵面具监督. 训练目标将二进制交叉进取与对数和Dice损失相结合: L = L BCE + L Dice. \ mathcal{ L}=\mathcal{ L}_{\mathrm{ BCE}}+\mathcal{ L}_{\mathrm{Dice}}}. (8) 这一目标既鼓励精确的像素分类,也鼓励预测的和地面真实操纵口罩之间的空间重叠。

blocks.en: Unless otherwise stated, all models are trained using an input resolution of 512 × 512 512\times 512 . Images are converted to RGB, resized to the target resolution, transformed into tensors, and normalized with ImageNet statistics. During training, we apply random horizontal flipping, color jitter, and B-Free-style image perturbations, including blur, JPEG recompression, down/up-scaling, and mild noise. At test time, only resizing, tensor conversion, and ImageNet normalization are applied.
blocks.zh: 除非另有说明,所有模型都使用512×512 512\times 512的输入分辨率进行训练. 图像转换成RGB,调整大小为目标分辨率,转换成百分数,并与ImageNet统计正常化. 在训练期间,我们采用随机水平翻转,色彩焦躁,和B-Free风格的图像扰动,包括模糊,JPEG重压,降/升缩,以及轻度噪音. 在测试时间,只应用了重定大小,拉伸转换,和ImageNet正常化.

blocks.en: The decoder is optimized with a learning rate of 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} , while unfrozen encoder layers are optimized with a lower learning rate of 5 × 10 − 6 5\times 10^{-6} . The batch size is set to 12, and the decoder dropout rate is set to 0.05. For all experiments, predicted probability maps are thresholded at 0.5 to obtain binary localization masks.
blocks.zh: 解码器优化的学习速度为1×10−4 1\times 10×4}而解冻的解码器层优化的学习速度为5×10−6 5\times 10×6}. 批量规模确定为12个,解码器辍学率确定为0.05个. 对所有实验,预测概率图的阈值为0.5,以获得二进制局部化口罩.

blocks.en: 4.3 Encoder Fine-Tuning Ablation
blocks.zh: 4.3 编码器微调

blocks.en: DinoLizer reports that keeping the DINO backbone frozen can improve localization performance. To investigate whether this observation also holds for the proposed DINO-FIL architecture, we conduct an encoder fine-tuning ablation. Specifically, we train variants in which different numbers of final DINOv3 transformer layers are unfrozen while the remaining encoder layers stay frozen.
blocks.zh: DinoLizer报告说,保持DINO骨干冷冻可以提高本地化性能. 为了调查这一观察是否也适用于提议的DINO-FIL架构,我们进行了编码器微调。 具体地说,我们训练变体,其中不同数量的最终DINOv3变压器层解冻,而其余的编码器层则保持冻结.

blocks.en: We evaluate six settings: 0, 6, 12, 16, 24, and 32 unfrozen transformer layers. The setting with 0 unfrozen layers corresponds to a fully frozen DINOv3 encoder, while the setting with 32 unfrozen layers fine-tunes the complete transformer backbone. All unfrozen encoder layers use the same encoder learning rate of 5 × 10 − 6 5\times 10^{-6} . This experiment tests whether adapting the pretrained DINOv3 backbone features, either partially or end-to-end, improves inpainting localization when used with the proposed decoder. Due to the large number of B-Free training images, all models in this experiment are trained for two epochs.
blocks.zh: 我们评价六个设置:0,6,12,16,24,以及32个解冻变压器层. 0解冻层的设置对应完全冷冻的DINOv3编码器,32解冻层的设置则微调了完整的变压器主干线. 所有解冻编码器层使用相同的编码器学习率为5×10−6 5\times 10×6}. 这种实验测试是部分或端到端调整预先训练的DINOv3主干功能,在使用拟议的解码器时会改进印版本地化. 由于大量B-Free训练图像,本实验中的所有模型都为两个纪元训练.

blocks.en: 4.4 Test Resolution Evaluation
blocks.zh: 4.4 测试分辨率评价

blocks.en: Although DINO-FIL is trained at 512 × 512 512\times 512 , we evaluate the trained models at both 512 × 512 512\times 512 and 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 test resolutions. This experiment measures whether higher-resolution inference improves localization by preserving finer manipulation traces, boundary artifacts, and texture inconsistencies that may be suppressed at lower resolution.
blocks.zh: 虽然DINO-FIL在512 × 512 512\times 512的训练中,我们以512 × 512 512\times 512和1024 × 1024 1024的测试分辨率来评价训练过的模型. 这一实验测量了高分辨率推论是否通过保存更细的操纵痕迹,边界文物,以及可能以较低分辨率压制的纹理不一致来改进本地化.

blocks.en: The comparison is particularly relevant because the benchmark datasets differ in their native image resolutions. B-Free consists of fixed 512 × 512 512\times 512 images, whereas other datasets contain images with more diverse resolutions and aspect ratios. Consequently, evaluating only at 512 × 512 512\times 512 may underestimate performance on datasets where additional high-frequency evidence is available in the original image.
blocks.zh: 这种比较特别相关,因为基准数据集的原生图像分辨率不同。 B-Free由固定的512×512 512\times 512图像组成,而其他数据集包含分辨率和侧面比更多样化的图像. 因此,仅在512×512 512\时间512进行评价,可能会低估数据集在原始图像中有更多高频证据的情况下的性能。

blocks.en: 4.5 Training Resolution Evaluation
blocks.zh: 4.5 培训分辨率评价

blocks.en: To further study the role of image resolution, we conduct a separate training-resolution experiment using SAGI-D as the training dataset. SAGI-D is suitable for this analysis because it contains images with a broad range of resolutions, including images smaller than 512 px and images larger than 1024 px. This contrasts with B-Free and CocoGlide, whose images have fixed resolutions of 512 × 512 512\times 512 and 256 × 256 256\times 256 , respectively.
blocks.zh: 为了进一步研究图像分辨率的作用,我们单独进行了一次使用SAGI-D作为培训数据集的培训分辨率实验. SAGI-D适合这种分析,因为它包含了具有广泛分辨率的图像,包括小于512px的图像和大于1024px的图像. 这与B-Free和CocoGlide形成对比,其图像分别固定了512×512512\times 512和256×256\times 256的分辨率.

blocks.en: In this experiment, we compare models trained at 512 × 512 512\times 512 and 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 . The ( 512 × 512 ) (512\times 512) -trained model is evaluated at both 512 × 512 512\times 512 and 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 , while the ( 1024 × 1024 ) (1024\times 1024) -trained model is evaluated at 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 . B-Free and CocoGlide are excluded from this experiment because their fixed low resolutions do not provide additional image information at 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 ; upsampling would merely duplicate existing pixels rather than introducing meaningful high-resolution evidence. Due to the large number of SAGI-D training images, all models in this experiment are trained for two epochs.

Thus, each image contributes equally to the final score, independent of the size of the manipulated region. Consequently, it is possible for one model to obtain a slightly lower mean IoU but a higher mean F1 than another model.

For this analysis, we use original, non-manipulated images from the SAGI-D test split, consisting of COCO, Open Images, and RAISE images. We report the pixel-level false-positive rate and the image-level true-negative rate. An image is counted as a true negative if no pixel exceeds the decision threshold of 0.5.
blocks.zh: 除了被操纵的图像本地化之外,我们还评价了原始图像上的假阳性. 对于这一分析,我们使用来自SAGI-D测试分裂的原创,非操纵的图像,由COCO,Open Images和RAISE图像组成. 我们报告像素级的假阳性率和图像级的真阴性率. 如果没有像素超过决定阈值0.5,则将图像算作真实负数。

blocks.en: 4.7 Comparison with Existing Detectors
blocks.zh: 4.7 与现有探测器的比较

blocks.en: We compare DINO-FIL against DinoLizer and TruFor, the two strongest-performing methods among the six detectors compared in the DinoLizer benchmark. For both baselines, we use the results reported in the DinoLizer paper. The reported baseline results are not based on externally downsampling all test images to a fixed resolution before inference: DinoLizer avoids downsampling through sliding-window inference, and TruFor processes arbitrary-size inputs and produces localization maps at input resolution. Since DinoLizer reports separate results for SAGI-SP and SAGI-FR, whereas we evaluate SAGI-D as a unified dataset, we aggregate the reported SAGI-SP and SAGI-FR scores into a single SAGI-D score using an image-count-weighted average. 1 1 1 We aggregate the two subsets rather than interpreting SAGI-SP and SAGI-FR separately because the SP/FR assignment of individual generators is not fully consistent across sources. In particular, DinoLizer reports Inpaint-Anything under SAGI-FR, whereas the SAGI-D definition categorizes Inpaint-Anything as SP because it preserves the unmasked region.
blocks.zh: 我们比较DINO-FIL与DinoLizer和TruFor,这是在DinoLizer基准中比较的6个探测器中表现最强的两种方法。 对于这两个基线,我们使用DinoLizer文件中所报告的结果。 报告的基准结果并非基于在推断前将所有测试图像取样到固定分辨率的外部: DinoLizer通过滑动窗口推论避免下取样,TruFor处理任意大小输入,并在输入分辨率时生成本地化地图. 由于DinoLizer报告SAGI-SP和SAGI-FR的单独结果,而我们评价SAGI-D是一个统一的数据集,所以我们利用一个图像计数加权平均值,将所报告的SAGI-SP和SAGI-FR的分数汇总为单一的SAGI-D分数. 页:1 1 我们汇总了两个子集,而不是分别解释SAGI-SP和SAGI-FR,因为SP/FR分配的单个发电机在来源之间并不完全一致. 特别是,DinoLizer在SAGI-FR下报告Inpaint-Anything,而SAGI-D的定义则将Inpaint-Anything归类为SP,因为它保留了未蒙面的区域.

blocks.en: 5 Results
blocks.zh: 5 结果

blocks.en: 5.1 Encoder Fine-Tuning and Test Resolution
blocks.zh: 5.1 编码器微调和测试分辨率

blocks.en: Table 1 : Comparison of DINO-FIL variants under different numbers of unfrozen encoder layers and test image resolutions (training resolution is fixed at 512px), evaluated using average pixel-level IoU and F1 score on image forgery localization. The best results are shown in bold, and the second-best results are underlined.
blocks.zh: 表1:不同数量解冻编码层和测试图像分辨率(训练分辨率定在512px)下的DINO-FIL变体的比较,在图像伪造本地化时使用平均像素级IoU和F1分数进行评估. 最佳结果以粗体表示,二佳结果以粗体显示。

blocks.en: Table 1 reports the localization performance of DINO-FIL when different numbers of final DINOv3 transformer layers are unfrozen and the model is evaluated at different test image resolutions. The results show that adapting the encoder yields higher test performance for the proposed architecture. With a fully frozen encoder, DINO-FIL achieves an average IoU/F1 of 0.51/0.58 at a test resolution of 512 × 512 512\times 512 and 0.58/0.67 at 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 . At 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 , unfreezing later transformer blocks consistently improves performance up to 24 unfrozen layers, although the gains become smaller as more layers are unfrozen. At 1024 × 1024 resolution, the model reaches its peak average IoU/F1 with 24 unfrozen layers. Fully unfreezing all 32 layers does not further improve the average result and slightly decreases the average F1 before rounding, from 0.774 to 0.771. This suggests that partial fine-tuning of the upper DINOv3 layers is sufficient, while full encoder fine-tuning provides diminishing returns.
blocks.zh: 表1报告DINO-FIL在不同的最终DINov3变压器层数解冻,模型在不同测试图像分辨率下评价时的本地化性能. 结果显示,调整编码器对拟议架构的测试性能较高。 DINO-FIL使用全冷凝编码器,在1024×1024 1024\1024\1024\1024的试验分辨率为512×512 512\512\512\512\5288/0.67 1024\1024\1024\1024\102410\10\10\10\10\10\10\10\10\10\10\10\10\10\10\10\10U10U10U10U10U10U10U10U10U10U10U10U10U10U10U10U10U10U10U10U10U10U10U10U10U10U10U10U10U10U10U10U10U10U10U10U10U10U1 achieve1o1o1o1o1o1o1o/F1o1o1o1o1U1U1U1U1U1U1U1U1U1U1U1U1U1U1U1U1U1U1U1U1U1U1U1U 在1024×1024 1024\times 1024,解冻后的变压器块持续改善性能,可达24个解冻层,不过随着更多层解冻,增益会变小. 在1024×1024分辨率时,该型号达到了峰值平均值IoU/F1,有24个解冻层. 所有32层均完全解冻,没有进一步改善平均结果,四舍五入前平均F1略有下降,从0.774降至0.771. 这表明对上部DINov3层的部分微调就足够了,而全编码器微调则提供了递减的回报.

blocks.en: A second clear trend is the effect of test resolution. Evaluating at 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 substantially improves performance on the cross-dataset test sets. Comparing the best-performing configurations at each resolution, the average IoU/F1 increases from 0.61/0.67 at 512 × 512 512\times 512 to 0.71/0.77 at 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 . This improvement is most pronounced on datasets with larger or more diverse native image resolutions: Beyond the Brush increases from 0.36/0.44 to 0.59/0.68, TGIF from 0.38/0.45 to 0.58/0.64, and SAGI-D from 0.59/0.67 to 0.66/0.73. These results suggest that higher-resolution inference can preserve manipulation traces, boundary inconsistencies, and local texture artifacts that may be suppressed when images are resized to 512 × 512 512\times 512 , making 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 evaluation better aligned with the available image evidence for higher-resolution datasets.
blocks.zh: 第二个明显的趋势是测试分辨率的效果。 在1024×1024 1024\times 1024进行评价,大大提高了跨数据集测试集的性能. 比较每个分辨率的最佳配置,平均IoU/F1从512×512 512\时的0.61/0.67增加到1024×1024\时的0.71/0.77。 1024 (英语). 这种改进在具有较大或更多样化本土图像分辨率的数据集中最为明显: 在刷子之外,TGIF从0.36/0.44增加到0.59/0.68,TGIF从0.38/0.45增加到0.58/0.64,SAGI-D从0.59/0.67增加到0.66/0.73。 这些结果表明,高分辨率推论可以保存操纵痕迹,边界不一致,局部纹理文物,当图像大小调整到512×512 512\times 512时时可以压制,使得1024×1024\time 1024评价更符合高分辨率数据集的现有图像证据.

blocks.en: CocoGlide also shows a small improvement, increasing from 0.87/0.92 to 0.88/0.93. However, this gain should be interpreted cautiously because CocoGlide images have a fixed resolution of 256 × 256 256\times 256 pixels. Evaluating these images at 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 therefore does not introduce additional high-frequency information, but only upsamples the existing pixels. The small observed increase may consequently be due to interpolation effects or random variation rather than a genuine resolution benefit.
blocks.zh: CocoGlide也有小幅改善,从0.87/0.92增加到0.88/0.93. 然而,这一增益应该谨慎解释,因为CocoGlide图像的固定分辨率为256×256256\times 256像素. 因此,在1024×1024 1024\times 1024中评估这些图像并不引入额外的高频信息,而只是对现有的像素进行提升. 因此,观察到的少量增加可能是由于内插效应或随机变化,而不是真正的解析效益。

blocks.en: The only exception is B-Free, where 512 × 512 512\times 512 evaluation performs slightly better than 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 evaluation. This is expected because B-Free consists of fixed 512 × 512 512\times 512 images and is also the training dataset for this experiment. As with CocoGlide, testing B-Free at 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 does not introduce additional image information, but instead upsamples the same image content.
blocks.zh: 唯一的例外是B-Free,其中512 × 512 512\times 512的评价表现略优于1024× 1024 1024\times 1024的评价. 这是因为B-Free由固定的512×512 512\times 512图像组成,也是这个实验的训练数据集. 和CocoGlide一样,在1024×1024 1024\times 1024测试B-Free并不引入额外的图像信息,而是提升了相同的图像内容.

blocks.en: Overall, the best average performance is obtained by the model with 24 unfrozen layers evaluated at 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 , achieving an average IoU/F1 of 0.71/0.77, with the fully fine-tuned model with 32 unfrozen layers obtaining nearly identical average performance. This indicates that partial fine-tuning of the final DINOv3 layers is sufficient for strong localization performance, while full end-to-end fine-tuning does not provide a clear additional benefit.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,模型获得最佳平均性能,以1024×1024 1024\times 1024的24个解冻层评价,平均IoU/F1达到0.71/0.77,完全微调的模型有32个解冻层获得几乎相同的平均性能. 这表明,对最终的DINOv3层进行部分微调,对于强大的本地化性能来说是足够的,而完全的端对端微调并不能提供明显的附加效益.

blocks.en: 5.2 Comparison with Existing Detectors
blocks.zh: 5.2 与现有探测器的比较

blocks.en: Table 2 : Comparison of DINO-FIL (ours) with DinoLizer and TruFor, the two strongest-performing methods reported in the DinoLizer benchmark [ 2 ] . Performance is reported using average pixel-level IoU and F1 score for image forgery localization. The SAGI-D results for DinoLizer and TruFor are computed as image-count-weighted averages of the reported SAGI-SP and SAGI-FR results. The best results are shown in bold, and the second-best results are underlined.
blocks.zh: 表2:DINO-FIL(我们)与DinoLizer和TruFor的比较,DinoLizer基准中报告的两种最强效方法[2]. 性能报告使用平均像素级IoU和F1分来进行图像伪造本地化. DinoLizer和TruFor的SAGI-D结果作为所报告的SAGI-SP和SAGI-FR结果的图像加权平均值计算。 最佳结果以粗体表示,二佳结果以粗体显示。

blocks.en: Table 2 compares DINO-FIL with DinoLizer and TruFor. For this comparison, we use the strongest-performing DINO-FIL variant from Table 1 , which unfreezes the final 24 DINOv3 transformer layers and is evaluated at 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 resolution. DINO-FIL achieves the best average performance across the benchmark, with an average IoU/F1 of 0.71/0.77. This is substantially higher than DinoLizer, which obtains 0.49/0.61, and TruFor, which obtains 0.36/0.43. DINO-FIL also achieves the best performance on four of the five evaluated datasets: Beyond the Brush, CocoGlide, SAGI-D, and B-Free.
blocks.zh: 表2将DINO-FIL与DinoLizer和TruFor进行比较。 为了进行这一比较,我们使用了表1中最强性能的DINO-FIL变体,该变体解冻了最后24个DINov3变压器层,并以1024×1024 1024\times 1024分辨率进行评价. DINO-FIL在整个基准中实现最佳平均业绩,平均IoU/F1为0.71.77. 这大大高于获得0.49/0.61的DinoLizer和获得0.36/0.43的TruFor。 DINO-FIL在5个评价数据集中的4个数据上也取得了最佳业绩: Brush之外还有CocoGlide、SAGI-D和B-Free。

blocks.en: The largest gains over DinoLizer are observed on CocoGlide and SAGI-D. On CocoGlide, DINO-FIL improves IoU from 0.57 to 0.87 and F1 from 0.69 to 0.92. On SAGI-D, DINO-FIL improves IoU from 0.38 to 0.66 and F1 from 0.49 to 0.73. These results indicate that the proposed multi-layer DINOv3 feature fusion decoder generalizes well across inpainting datasets and benefits from high-resolution inference.
blocks.zh: 在CocoGlide和SAGI-D上观察到比DinoLizer最大的增益。 在CocoGlide上,DINO-FIL将IoU从0.57改进为0.87,F1从0.69改进为0.92。 在SAGI-D上,DINO-FIL将IoU从0.38改进为0.66,F1从0.49改进为0.73. 这些结果表明,拟议的多层DINov3特性的聚变解码器能很好地泛泛地覆盖各组内漆数据集,并从高分辨率推论中获益。

blocks.en: TruFor achieves the strongest result on TGIF, with an IoU/F1 of 0.70/0.80, while DINO-FIL obtains 0.57/0.63. This is the only dataset on which DINO-FIL does not obtain the best result. Nevertheless, DINO-FIL remains the second-best method on TGIF and outperforms TruFor by a large margin on all other datasets.
blocks.zh: TruFor在TGIF上取得了最强的成绩,IoU/F1为0.70/0.80,而DINO-FIL则获得0.57/0.63. 这是DINO-FIL没有获得最佳结果的唯一数据集. 尽管如此,DINO-FIL仍然是TGIF和业绩优异的第二最佳方法 TruFor在所有其他数据集上以很大的差值显示.

blocks.en: The comparison should be interpreted as a benchmark-level comparison rather than a fully controlled retraining study. The DinoLizer and TruFor scores are taken from the DinoLizer benchmark. TruFor, however, was not trained on TGIF, as stated in the TruFor paper. Despite this limitation, the results show that DINO-FIL provides strong cross-dataset localization performance relative to the best-performing methods reported in the DinoLizer benchmark.
blocks.zh: 比较应解释为基准水平的比较,而不是完全控制的再培训研究。 DinoLizer和TruFor的分数取自DinoLizer基准. 然而,如TruFor论文所述,TruFor没有接受过关于TGIF的培训。 尽管有这一限制,但结果显示,相对于DinoLizer基准中所报告的最佳方法,DINO-FIL提供了强大的跨数据集本地化性能.

blocks.en: 5.3 False Positives on Pristine Images
blocks.zh: 5.3 原始图像上的假阳性

blocks.en: Table 3 : False-positive evaluation of DINO-FIL on original, non-manipulated images. We report the pixel-level false-positive rate and the image-level true-negative rate. The average is computed over all images across the three datasets.
blocks.zh: 表3:在未经控制的原始图像上对DINO-FIL的虚假评价。 我们报告像素级的假阳性率和图像级的真阴性率. 平均数字是在三个数据集的所有图像中计算的。

blocks.en: Table 3 evaluates DINO-FIL on pristine, non-manipulated images from the SAGI-D test split. For this evaluation, we use the strongest-performing DINO-FIL variant from Table 1 , which unfreezes the final 24 DINOv3 transformer layers and is evaluated at 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 resolution. Across 9,081 original images from COCO, Open Images, and RAISE, the model obtains a pixel-level false-positive rate of 0.0032 and an image-level true-negative rate of 0.9719 at the fixed threshold of 0.5.
blocks.zh: 表3从SAGI-D的测试分裂中,对原始的,非操纵的图像进行DINO-FIL评价. 对于本次评价,我们使用表1中最强性能的DINO-FIL变体,该变体解冻了最后24个DINov3变压器层,并以1024×1024 1024\times 1024分辨率进行评价. 在COCO,Open Images,以及RAISE的9,081个原始图像上,模型在0.5的固定阈值下获得像素级假阳性率为0.0032,图像级真阴性率为0.9719.

blocks.en: DINO-FIL achieves high true-negative rates across all three pristine-image subsets, with 97.67% on COCO, 96.84% on Open Images, and 98.10% on RAISE. These results suggest that DINO-FIL is not only effective at localizing manipulated regions but also relatively conservative on pristine images. However, a low false-positive rate does not by itself guarantee that every predicted region in a manipulated image is spatially correct. Rather, it indicates that, under the chosen threshold, predicted inpainted regions are uncommon on pristine-image inputs.
blocks.zh: DINO-FIL在所有三个原始图像子集中都实现了高真实负率,COCO为97.67%,Open Images为96.84%,RAISE为98.10%. 这些结果表明,DINO-FIL不仅能够有效地将受操纵区域本地化,而且在原始图像上也相对保守。 然而,低假阳性率本身并不能保证被操纵图像中每个预测的区域在空间上是正确的. 相反,它表明,在选定的阈值下,预测的无油漆区域在原始图像输入方面并不常见。

blocks.en: 5.4 Effect of Training Resolution
blocks.zh: 5.4 培训决议的效果

blocks.en: Table 4 : Comparison of DINO-FIL variants trained at different resolutions (512px and 1024px) and evaluated at corresponding test resolutions for image forgery localization. Performance is reported in terms of average pixel-level IoU and F1 score across datasets. The best results are shown in bold, and the second-best results are underlined.
blocks.zh: 表4:不同分辨率(512px和1024px)培训的DINO-FIL变体的比较,并在相应的测试分辨率上评价成像本地化. 业绩按数据集平均像素水平IoU和F1分数报告。 最佳结果以粗体表示,二佳结果以粗体显示。

blocks.en: Motivated by the superior performance observed when evaluating DINO-FIL at 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 , Table 4 studies whether this benefit also transfers to training at higher resolution. All models in this experiment are based on the strongest-performing encoder configuration identified in Table 1 , i.e., DINO-FIL with the final 24 DINOv3 transformer layers unfrozen.
blocks.zh: 在1024×1024 1024\1024\times 1024评估DINO-FIL时观察到的优异表现激励下,表4研究了这一效益是否也转移到更高分辨率的培训. 这个实验中的所有模型都是基于表1中所确定的最强性能的编码器配置,即DINO-FIL与最后24个DINov3变压器层解冻.

blocks.en: This experiment is independent from the B-Free training experiment because the models are trained on SAGI-D instead. Therefore, the absolute numbers should not be compared directly with the B-Free-trained models in Table 1 .
blocks.zh: 这个实验独立于B-Free训练实验,因为模型是用SAGI-D来训练的. 因此,绝对数字不应直接与表1中的B-Free训练模型进行比较。

blocks.en: The results show that high-resolution inference also improves performance for DINO-FIL trained on SAGI-D at 512 × 512 512\times 512 . For the model trained at this resolution, average IoU/F1 increases from 0.51/0.56 when evaluated at 512 × 512 512\times 512 to 0.71/0.78 when evaluated at 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 .
blocks.zh: 结果显示,高分辨率推论也提高了在512×512 512\时间512时接受SAGI-D训练的DINO-FIL的性能. 对于本决议所训练的模型,平均IoU/F1从512×512 512\时评价的0.51/0.56增加到1024×1024 1024\时评价的0.71/0.78.

blocks.en: However, training directly at 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 does not further improve average performance in this experiment. The model trained and tested at 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 achieves an average IoU/F1 of 0.68/0.74, which is below the 512 × 512 512\times 512 -trained model evaluated at 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 . The only dataset where 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 training slightly improves IoU is SAGI-D, where IoU increases from 0.83 to 0.84 while F1 remains unchanged at 0.88.
blocks.zh: 然而,在1024×1024 1024\times 1024直接进行训练,并不能进一步提高本次实验的平均性能. 该型号在1024×1024 1024\times 1024实现平均IoU/F1 0.68/0.74,低于512×512 512\times 512——在1024×1024 1024\times 1024\times 1024评价的训练型号. 1024×1024 1024\Times 1024培训稍有改进的唯一数据集是SAGI-D,IOU从0.83增加到0.84,而F1保持不变,为0.88.

blocks.en: Several factors may explain this result. First, most SAGI-D images are not substantially larger than 1024 1024 px: only about 21% have a maximum side length of at least 1024 1024 px, while the majority fall between 512 512 px and 1024 1024 px. Consequently, training at 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 may not consistently expose the model to genuinely higher-resolution evidence.
blocks.zh: 有几个因素可以解释这一结果。 首先,大多数SAGI-D图像的大小不明显大于1024 1024 px:只有约21%的侧线长度最大,至少为1024 1024 px,而大多数在512 512 px和1024 1024 px之间. 因此,1024×1024 1024\times 1024的训练可能无法一贯地使该型号暴露在真正更高分辨率的证据面前.

blocks.en: Second, training at 512 × 512 512\times 512 may act as a form of scale regularization. When combined with 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 inference, the model may still exploit high-frequency cues in the test images while retaining stronger cross-dataset generalization from the lower-resolution training setting.
blocks.zh: 其次,512×512 512\时间512的培训可以作为一种规模化规范化的形式. 当与1024×1024 1024\times 1024推论结合时,该模型仍然可能在测试图像中利用高频提示,同时保留较强的跨数据集通用化从低分辨率训练环境.

blocks.en: These findings suggest that high-resolution inference is beneficial for DINO-FIL, whereas high-resolution training does not provide an additional benefit under the fixed-resolution setup evaluated here. This indicates that the relationship between training resolution, test resolution, and dataset image statistics requires further investigation.
blocks.zh: 这些调查结果表明,高分辨率推断对DINO-FIL有益,而高分辨率培训在本文评价的固定分辨率设置下不提供额外好处。 这表明培训分辨率、测试分辨率和数据集图像统计之间的关系需要进一步调查。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: This paper presented DINO-FIL, a dense inpainting localization model that combines intermediate DINOv3 representations with a lightweight multi-layer feature fusion decoder. Instead of relying only on the final transformer output, DINO-FIL exploits hidden states from multiple backbone depths and fuses them through projection, context aggregation, and top-down refinement. This design allows the model to combine local appearance cues, texture-sensitive intermediate representations, and deeper semantic information for pixel-level inpainting localization.
blocks.zh: 本文介绍了DINO-FIL,一种密集的涂装局部化模型,结合了中间的DINOv3表示和轻量级多层特性聚变解码器. DINO-FIL不只依赖最终变压器输出,而是利用隐藏状态从多个主干深度中分离出来,并通过投影,上下文聚合,自上而下的精细化来熔化它们. 这种设计使得模型可以结合局部的外观提示,纹理敏感的中间表现,以及更深层次的语义信息,用于像素级的印记本地化.

blocks.en: The experimental results show that DINO-FIL achieves strong cross-dataset generalization when trained on B-Free and evaluated on five inpainting localization benchmarks. Partial fine-tuning of the DINOv3 encoder improves performance over a fully frozen backbone, with the best average result obtained by unfreezing the final 24 transformer layers and evaluating at 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 resolution. Compared with DinoLizer and TruFor, DINO-FIL achieves the highest average IoU and F1 score and obtains the best performance on four of the five evaluated datasets. The false-positive analysis on pristine SAGI-D images further shows that the model remains conservative on non-manipulated inputs, achieving a low pixel-level false-positive rate and a high image-level true-negative rate.
blocks.zh: 实验结果显示,DINO-FIL在接受B-Free培训并按5个插入本地化基准进行评估时,实现了强跨数据集的概括化. 部分微调DINOv3编码器在完全冷冻的骨干上提高性能,通过解冻最后24个变压器层,并以1024×1024 1024\times 1024分辨率进行评价,获得最佳平均结果. 与DinoLizer和TruFor相比,DINO-FIL取得了IoU和F1平均分数最高的成绩,并在5个评价数据集中的4个获得了最佳表现. 对原始的SAGI-D图像的假阳性分析进一步显示,模型在非操纵输入上仍然保守,实现了像素水平的低假阳性率和高图像水平的真阴性率.

blocks.en: The resolution experiments indicate that high-resolution inference is particularly important for inpainting localization. Evaluating at 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 substantially improves performance on datasets with larger or more diverse native image resolutions, suggesting that fine manipulation traces, boundary artifacts, and texture inconsistencies can be suppressed by lower-resolution resizing. However, training directly at 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 does not provide a consistent additional benefit in the fixed-resolution setup evaluated here. Instead, it yields slightly lower average performance than training at 512 × 512 512\times 512 and evaluating at 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 . This suggests that the relationship between training resolution, test resolution, and dataset image statistics is more nuanced than simply increasing both resolutions.
blocks.zh: 分辨率实验表明,高分辨率推论对于涂抹局部化特别重要. 在1024×1024 1024\times 1024对本地图像分辨率较大或更多样化的数据集进行评价,大大提高了数据集的性能,表明精细的操纵痕迹,边界文物和纹理不一致可以通过低分辨率重排来抑制. 然而,在1024×1024 1024\times 1024直接进行训练并不能在本文评价的固定分辨率设置中提供一致的额外好处. 相反,在512×512 512\Times 512和1024×1024\Times 1024的评测中,其平均成绩略低于培训。 这表明,培训分辨率、测试分辨率和数据集图像统计之间的关系比简单地增加两种分辨率要细微。

blocks.en: 6.1 Future Work
blocks.zh: 6.1 未来工作

blocks.en: The observation that high-resolution inference is beneficial, whereas high-resolution training does not provide an additional benefit under the fixed-resolution setup evaluated here, suggests that the interaction between training resolution, test resolution, and dataset image statistics requires further investigation.
blocks.zh: 高分辨率推论是有益的,而高分辨率培训在本文评价的固定分辨率设置下并不提供额外好处,这表明培训分辨率、测试分辨率和数据集图像统计之间的相互作用需要进一步调查。

blocks.en: Future work should therefore investigate adaptive-resolution training and evaluation strategies. One possible approach is to group images according to their native resolution and process them at higher target resolutions only when sufficient high-resolution evidence is available. Since the DINOv3 backbone uses a patch size of 16, these target resolutions should be chosen as multiples of 16 to avoid implicit cropping of the input image as described in the DINOv3 model card [ 11 ] .
blocks.zh: 因此,今后的工作应调查适应性分辨率培训和评价战略。 一种可能的做法是,只有在有足够的高分辨率证据时,才按照原生分辨率对图像进行分组,并将其处理到更高的目标分辨率。 由于DINOv3主干线使用补丁尺寸为16,因此这些目标分辨率应选为16倍,以避免暗中裁剪DINOv3模式卡[11]中描述的输入图像.

blocks.en: Another promising direction is parameter-efficient adaptation of the backbone using Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA). Compared to full or partial fine-tuning of transformer layers, LoRA introduces trainable low-rank updates while keeping the pretrained weights frozen, potentially improving efficiency and reducing overfitting. Yu et al. [ 14 ] explored LoRA-style adaptation for DINO-based forensic backbones, suggesting that it may improve performance compared to full fine-tuning. Integrating LoRA with the proposed multi-layer feature fusion architecture is therefore a promising direction for enhancing the DINO’s representational capacity.
blocks.zh: 另一个有希望的方向是使用低Rank适应(LORA)对骨干进行参数效率改造. 与变压器层的完整或部分微调相比,LORA引入了可列车的低档更新,同时将预列的重量保持冷冻,有可能提高效率,降低超装. 余等编. [14] 探索了基于DINO的法证主干线的LORA风格改造,认为与全面微调相比,它可能会提高性能. 因此,将LORA与拟议的多层次特征组合结构结合起来,是提高DINO代表能力的一个有希望的方向。
